integrity: The conclusions follow from autocorrelation identities and a real two-coordinate singular-spectrum computation. Finite tests supplement but are not a proof. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional finitely supported complex sequences with one known spike exactly at index 2n; no claims for general backgrounds or closer configurations. Conditional stability holds with earlier recovered coefficients fixed.
title: Critical-gap one-dimensional Fourier holography: exact fibers and singular values
